title: Minimum Balance for a Payment Arrangement, Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
A past-due Repair and Emergency Service Calls balance may be spread over installments only above a minimum balance. The minimum depends on whether the call's unit is protected under Harbison Protection Contracts and on whether the customer holds an active Comfort Club agreement. The records read are the protection contracts in active status and the unit each covers, and the agreement's status.

**Rule.** An arrangement is open only when the balance owing is at least:

- 300 dollars on a call for a unit covered by an active Harbison protection contract;
- 500 dollars on any other call of a customer with an active agreement;
- 750 dollars on every other call.

A smaller balance is paid in one installment.

| Call | Minimum balance for an arrangement |
|---|---|
| Call's unit covered by an active Harbison protection contract | $300.00 |
| Any other call of a customer with an active Comfort Club agreement | $500.00 |
| Every other call | $750.00 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical balances)

| Call | Balance owing | Arrangement open |
|---|---|---|
| Protected unit | $300.00 | Yes |
| Protected unit | $299.99 | No, one installment |
| Member, unit not protected | $500.00 | Yes |
| Member, unit not protected | $450.00 | No, one installment |
| Non-member, unit not protected | $749.99 | No, one installment |
